description: List the followers of a Chat channel (ClickUp Chat v3) — users who receive notifications without necessarily being members. Paginated via `cursor`/`limit`.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel whose followers to list.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (the `next_cursor` returned by a previous call). Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return in this page.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: get_chat_channel_followers
